title: Scoutboard: Concise Failure Hierarchy & Snapshot Quickflows
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Design a compact, glancable console surface (Scoutboard) that surfaces a hierarchical summary of failures across models/routes and provides one-tap snapshot quickflows to inspect payloads, trigger safe replays, or open a focused payload diff. The goal is an at-a-glance taxonomy for on-call and SREs that reduces friction when triaging noisy error spikes and enables safe, time-boxed exploration without leaving the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: A hierarchical failure strip shows top-10 error clusters by volume and latency impact and can be expanded to show sample signatures without navigation
Snapshot quickflow available from each cluster: View payload, view diffs (earliest vs latest), trigger read-only replay, open full request inspector
Compact minimap shows temporal density and a draggable window to zoom chart+payload list; interactions maintain context across rollouts and cost overlays
Accessible keyboard affordances for power users (expand/collapse clusters, next/prev snapshot) and clear affordances for sensitive data redaction
Prototype validated with two on-call engineers and one SRE; at least 3 actionable UX issues captured and documented before final handoff
progress_updates: 2026-02-12 - Arielle Chen: Kickoff meeting with PM, Eng (runtime + console) and SRE. Collected pain points: long tail of noisy 400/429 errors, developers losing context when jumping to full request view.
2026-02-18 - Matèo Alvarez: Low-fidelity nav completed; two compact patterns proposed (strip list vs nested cards). Engineering flagged performance concern for prefetching payloads on expand.
2026-02-25 - Arielle Chen: Mid-fidelity prototype with minimap and snapshot quickflows completed. Usability session scheduled with on-call cohort for 2026-03-03.

2026-03-04 - Mateo Alvarez: Usability session notes uploaded. Observations: users wanted clear provenance for snapshot timestamps and an explicit safe-mode for replays. Added 'read-only replay' UX state.
2026-03-10 - Arielle Chen: Final prototype polish and accessibility pass. Created handoff board with engineering tasks and data gating checklist.
2026-03-12 - Mateo Alvarez: Handoff meeting with eng pairing; flagged two follow-ups: (1) API for snapshot TTL and redaction, (2) telemetry hooks for cluster sampling decisions.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Priya Nair (PM): Love the focus on quickcontext. Please ensure cost overlays are toggleable — some customers run high-volume internal jobs where this view would be noisy.
2026-02-18 - Jordan Li (Eng, runtime): Concern: prefetching full payloads for 100 clusters might be heavy. Recommend lazy load + size limit with preview extractor.
2026-03-03 - Sloane Reed (SRE): During the session we needed a way to pin a cluster to a temporal window and persist that across refreshes. Could we add a 'pin viewport' affordance?
2026-03-04 - Mateo Alvarez: Added 'pin viewport' to next iteration, and introduced a TTL-based snapshot cache.
decisions: 2026-02-20: Chosen compact strip pattern over nested cards to maximize scannability on dense dashboards
2026-03-04: Implement read-only replay state for safe exploration; write replay actions require explicit opt-in and audit logging
2026-03-10: Use server-side snapshot extractor to produce size-limited, redacted payload previews; full payload fetch gated by role/permission
review_feedback: 2026-03-05 - PM review (Priya): Add more explicit labels for customer-facing versus internal-only errors to help support route priority
2026-03-07 - Design review (Kenji Okafor): Visual hierarchy good; reduce card density on <1280px screens and collapse minimap by default
2026-03-09 - Accessibility review (Rae Kim): Ensure color contrast on cluster badges meets AA; keyboard focus order validated on prototype
2026-03-11 - Engineering review (Jordan Li): Provided API contract sketch and cautioned about sampling biases; added backend tasks in PR
next_steps: Break design into deliverables: UI components (compact strip, minimap, snapshot modal), interaction spec, accessibility checklist
Work with Eng to finalize snapshot API contract and sampling telemetry (issue ENG-29104)
Schedule 1:1 walkthrough with SRE on pinned viewport persistence and audit log expectations
